title: Lip-sync video exports work again
summary: Lip-sync video exports work again, lip-synced voices are heard in audio-only exports, and a welcome video greets new members on the dashboard.

items.body: New members see a short welcome video on their first dashboard visit
Watch it again with **Watch welcome video** in Cmd+K
Lip-sync video exports run again, and a clip is never charged twice
Lip-synced cards play their dub in audio-only exports
Exports with lip-sync off work on projects with lip-synced cards
